families.name: Literal, run-length and sparse coding
families.definition: Store bytes, runs or exception positions when that is cheapest.
families.cix_status: Existing native/reference mechanisms; fallback is essential.

families.name: Enumerative/combinatorial coding
families.definition: Transmit a count/model and an index among its valid objects; rank/unrank must be exact.
families.cix_status: Existing native rank, multinomial/count and histogram machinery. This is established enumerative coding, not a new universal generator theorem.

families.name: Huffman, arithmetic/range and ANS/FSE
families.definition: Turn a probability/count model into a uniquely decodable bitstream.
families.cix_status: Native Huffman/range mechanisms; FSE through retained libzstd. A standalone native rANS expert stream is a separate unqualified route; earlier N3 disposition remains closed.

families.name: LZ and dictionaries
families.definition: Replace recurring strings with earlier references or dictionary symbols.
families.cix_status: Native bounded LZ and retained DEFLATE/LZMA/Brotli/Zstd backends. Trained reusable dictionaries are a separate required RC26 item, not proved by a phrase dictionary.

families.name: LZP, ROLZ and context symbol ranking
families.definition: Predict a match or rank using context, reducing the reference/symbol description.
families.cix_status: libbsc supplies LZP. General ROLZ and original-order symbol-ranking coverage not established. BWT MTF ranks and combinadic ranks are different.

families.name: BWT, move-to-front and sorting transforms
families.definition: Reorder contexts before coding clustered symbols/ranks.
families.cix_status: Native/reference BWT plus bzip2/libbsc backends; GPU acceleration unqualified.

families.name: PPM, CTW and DMC
families.definition: Assign probabilities from context trees or dynamically adapted/cloned states.
families.cix_status: Native PPM; binary CTW reference-only; DMC state cloning present in retained PAQ. They are not interchangeable algorithms.

families.name: Context mixing and calibration
families.definition: Combine predictors and refine their output probabilities.
families.cix_status: FixedMix and retained PAQ/ZPAQ. ZPAQ SSE/ISSE is distinct from FixedMix and PPM escape estimation. Frozen predictive trials did not qualify a new mixer.

families.name: Neural probability prediction
families.definition: Use a learned recurrent/transformer model to predict symbols before entropy coding.
families.cix_status: The automatic BEST portfolio retains paq-v215-9L (level 9, LSTM enabled) as its bounded LSTM-bearing PAQ trial. It is not a separate transform or decoder. The distinct -12L configuration remains over the accepted budget; NNCP/LibNC and larger learned models are research references, not accepted native routes.

families.name: Numeric and bit-layout transforms
families.definition: Expose regularity using deltas, XOR, strides, planes, residuals and exact packing.
families.cix_status: Existing numeric/chain/bitplane foundations; Pco/ALP/Elf-style implementations need separate comparison.

families.name: Spatial prediction, lifting and image coding
families.definition: Represent correlated neighbours/axes with reversible transforms and coded residuals.
families.cix_status: Existing/reference wavelet and volume work; retained JXL/JLS/J2K specialists require full native parity. JXL bridge inspected is gray2d pixel coding.

families.name: Structured records, graphs and executable relationships
families.definition: Separate fields and encode valid relations with exact exceptions and original envelopes.
families.cix_status: Retained format-aware successes and partial native ports. Recognition must use supplied bytes and validated structure, never corpus identity.

families.name: Grammar and reusable abstractions
families.definition: Describe recurring phrases recursively and encode a grammar that generates the input.
families.cix_status: Phrase mechanisms exist; no complete Re-Pair/GCIS/GLZA implementation established in the inspected source. Program-library synthesis was considered as research.

families.name: Segmentation, typed graphs and paid selection
families.definition: Choose complete representations for input-derived regions, paying boundaries, resets and model IDs.
families.cix_status: Required heterogeneous architecture and partial orchestration; complete automatic native engine still unqualified. OpenZL/CAST and segmentation research were already considered.

families.name: Exact recompression and encoder residuals
families.definition: Rebuild an original compressed stream from its content plus the encoder decisions needed for exact reproduction.
families.cix_status: Retain demonstrated PAQ DEFLATE capability; finite gzip/bzip2/ZIP prototypes retain closed dispositions. JPEG and audio reconstruction are separate capabilities.

families.name: Constraints, latent variables and model-set indexes
families.definition: Describe a tractable restricted set/model, then code the input or its residual within it.
families.cix_status: BDD/DAG/counting, bits-back, SDL, seeded maps, conditional modelling and synthesis have known antecedents. Most CIX variants are bounded research with scoped negative results.

families.name: Parallelism and implementation efficiency
families.definition: Reduce computation, allocation, memory movement and sequential dependence while preserving the coded contract.
families.cix_status: CPU optimisation and bounded concurrency remain required; GPU work is conditional. Faster coding does not itself discover more statistical redundancy.
